He wants something in a month's time - Ian Hamilton, owner.

quotes.race: MND Association Race For Research Lightning Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: That was just the job. Tommy's Oscar wants better ground and a flat track. He'll go to Aintree, I suppose. He's not a Cheltenham horse, it's too undulating for him. We'd like to find another race for him but Ann and I are getting on a bit and we cannot travel too far. Ian Hamilton, assistant trainer.

quotes.race: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Arkle Challenge Trophy Trial Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Tommy's Oscar has done nothing wrong. it got a bit tight turning in but that's racing and he's used to it. He settled a lot better than when he ran in the Champion Hurdle. He ran a blinder. He prefers a flat track but he came down the hill okay - Danny McMenamin, rider.  He boiled over. We've got the diesel money for the way home. Danny said he needed the run again. We'll come back for the Arkle. He's entered in the Fighting Fifth and he could go there, it's just down the road for us - Ian Hamilton.

quotes.race: Book Your Christmas Party Now Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: They went fast and didn't hang about. Tommy's Oscar was badly in need of a run and will come on a ton. He jumped like a buck and straight as a die, so he's a super jumper. We only schooled him once but he's run in point-to-points in the past. We'll look at the valuable graduation race here next month and if he goes and wins that we'll probably stop over fences. A lot of people say you shouldn't go back to hurdles [once you go chasing] but I'm pleased we've got him and he's a fair horse - Ian Hamilton, owner.

quotes.race: 'The New One' Unibet Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Champion Hurdle Trial Race)
quotes.quote: Tommy's Oscar is a lovely horse who tries his best. He's very straightforward and does everything you ask and if we're going to have a go at Cheltenham, I suppose this is the year to do it, while the horses are well - Ann Hamilton, trainer.

quotes.race: bet365 Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Tommy's Oscar did well off topweight after going up 9lb from the last day. I don't need to sing the praises of the trainer anymore - she's fantastic - Brian Hughes, jockey.

quotes.race: Betfair Pays Tribute To Andy Stewart Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Tommy's Oscar was good today. He didn't get the trip at Carlisle on heavy ground. It was different today on an easier track over two mile three on better ground. He's a chaser but the other one in the next [Pay The Piper] is similarly handicapped, so where do you go? We will chase him but we always thought there was a decent hurdle in him first - Ian Hamilton, owner.

stable_tour.quote: He just didn't run his race last time at Kelso, which was his first time out this season, but he's well. There's just been little bits of setbacks, but he's on the way back and the plan is to go Kelso on December 8. It's a new two-mile open handicap at the track and we like to try to stay as local as possible with him, but a lot of the high-rated handicaps he could run in are further south. He's on track and we're happy with him. 25-11-24

quotes.race: Download The Bet Victor App Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Slanagaibhgoleir has been disappointing but I would say the step up to 3m suited. He picked up well from the mistake at the last and you would have to be pleased - Gordon Elliott, trainer

stable_tour.quote: He had a nice run in a maiden hurdle at Punchestown last season and should progress this year. 24-10-23

quotes.race: Virgin Bet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Whistleinthedark has been going well since he went chasing and I was hopeful coming here today. He's been progressive and I think he'll go to Aintree next month for a handicap - Laura Morgan, trainer.

quotes.race: Tysers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I thought turning in I'd win well. Didn't jump the last well but didn't lose any ground and I thought Whistleinthedark would go away away and win well but he's had to dig deep - Brendan Powell, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: He joined us this season and his two runs have been encouraging. He finished a half-length second at Ayr and on Boxing Day put that experience to good use with an easy win in a 2m5½f handicap chase at Market Rasen. He's much better over fences than hurdles and is going to give us a lot of fun, although his 12lb hike in the handicap is not going to help. 18-01-23

prev_owners.owner: F W Healy & Ms Margaret Mullins

quotes.race: Betfred 'Classic Bookmaker' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: On form, Classic Maestro should have done that. It's a shame only two turned up, but his jumping was foot-perfect. He's kept improving and there should be more to come. We'll freshen him up for a couple of weeks, but he loves heavy ground and we'll have to make use of that. He should get further and can step up to two and a half miles - Alan O'Keeffe, assistant trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He was pulled up in the Ascot Chase last time. Before that he was second at Sandown in January behind Lucy Wadham's Jax Junior, who then won the Grade 2 Pendil. He has an entry at Cheltenham in the Grand Annual but would run only on soft or heavy ground. We'll enter him everywhere just to find that ground. He'll also have an entry in the Topham at Aintree. His jumping is his forte and he's my trainer's pick. 04-03-26

runners.comment: Has a very solid record here and could play a leading role if fully tuned up after a break
runners.spotlight: Made a good start to his chasing career last year, winning three times between May and September (2m3f/2m4f, good), with two of them over C&D; also effective on good to soft, unproven on softer; he has a very solid record here and could play a leading role if fully tuned up after a break.

quotes.race: Francky Du Berlais Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I couldn't believe King Roly was backed so much. The way he was jumping over fences at home was electric. He was a bit sticky early on, but he warmed to it. I think he'll be a good chaser, he stays all day and will be the type for a summer national - Mickey Bowen, trainer,

stable_tour.quote: There's a novice handicap chase at Perth at their three-day festival next month that he'll go for. He's really well and I'm hoping he'll keep on improving throughout the late spring and summer months. I'm sure he could be one of ours to go for the Summer Plate at Market Rasen. 26-03-26

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Haie Neuve Et Al

stable_tour.quote: Since last seen on the track, he's nearly died of colic and needed major surgery. He's back now and I hope he can remain competitive, in the right grade and when conditions are suitable; he's best on decent ground. I'll be looking for a two-and-a-half-mile handicap round one of the smaller courses towards the end of the month. 04-11-25

The handicapper hasn't missed him and Cheltenham last week was too big an ask. Since he's had the blinkers on, he's jumped much straighter. We'll look at getting him back on track in the north. 29-10-25

prev_owners.owner: The Box 8 Partnership & Avon Racing Ltd
The Box 8 Partnership And M Harris

quotes.race: Keogh & Hows Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Westerninthepark is a nice horse and jumped very well for a newcomer. The race fell apart a bit late on but he was well on top at the finish and that was a perfect start over fences - Olly Murphy, trainer.

quotes.race: British EBF "National Hunt" Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Westerninthepark handled the ground well. It's a sharp track for a big horse like him but he jumped well, did everything nicely and quickened up well. Fences and a trip will be his thing going forward - Harry Cobden, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

stable_tour.quote: He needs soft ground and big, galloping tracks. He didn't get his ground at Cheltenham in the Kim Muir. I think he could be competitive in a nice three-mile-plus handicap chase this season. He's ready to go but we just need plenty of rain. 23-10-25

quotes.race: William Hill Ten Up Novice Chase (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: American Mike is probably one of the horses that makes me scratch my head more than any other. He keeps disappointing me and then he comes back with a good one again. He has obviously a big engine on his day, when he's right, but he's not easy to train. He's in a few of the novice chases at Cheltenham and he could go for an Irish National - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: American Mike finished his race out today, which is the first time he has done it since he was a bumper horse. I'm absolutely thrilled, that meant as much as the rest of the winners. To get him back to where we have him now, I'm thrilled. And Jack has put an awful lot of work into his schooling. He'll go somewhere at Christmas, maybe to the Grade 1 at Limerick - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: American Mike didn't really do much, he was always just in second gear. He was a bit novicey and there is plenty of improvement in him. He will be a 2m4f plus horse - Gordon Elliott, trainer

quotes.race: Weatherbys Champion Bumper (A Standard Open National Hunt Flat Race) (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It was a great race and I think we've seen a very good horse there (Facile Vega) but American Mike is very good too. We lost nothing in defeat and they'll be two great horses for the future - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Future Champions INH Flat Race (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: American Mike did what we expected. He could go to the Dublin Racing Festival but I would say he will go straight to Cheltenham. I think he's a proper horse. Jamie said it was a proper race and they went a proper gallop - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He ran fine at Newbury first time for me and he's had a wind operation since. He was a big talking horse for Gordon [Elliott]. He's going to have a prep run and then we'll enter him up. He ran in the Grand Annual last year and I'd love to go up in trip and float him round. The engine is still there.  12-02-26

quotes.race: Virgin Bet Old Roan Limited Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I'd say Minella Drama has been our flagship horse for a few years now and he deserved it. He's been placed in this race and a Melling Chase, so it's good he got his day in the sun - Brian Hughes, rider.

quotes.race: Jewson Fast Set Finish Old Roan Limited Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Minella Drama ran a screamer and it's not sour grapes but the way he's gone through the race and jumped, you'd have to think he would have won if the fences were in. It's a shame because it's a great race with a lot of good horses, but it's not the best watch in the world with a bunch of good chasers off the bridle more than four furlongs up the straight. It happens every year, so they're going to have to do something. Whether they have it early or later, I don't know - Donald McCain, trainer.

quotes.race: Marsh Chase (Registered As The Melling Chase) (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It has to be the right conditions for Minella Drama to go against the others (if he is to win a Grade One). He goes on deep ground and goes on soft ground. You have to remember he was second in a Grade One as a novice hurdler, he's a smart horse. He is not the easiest to train. Adrian Lane lives with him and rides him every day and Brian makes it look a lot more simple than it actually is to be honest as he is a bit of a wild man. There will be a day when circumstances are right and we can capitalise on it.

quotes.race: Patrick Coyne Memorial Altcar Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Minella Drama is a genuine Grade 1 performer. It's been a slow process with him because he is wild in everything he does. You keep him away from other horses, his tail goes round and he does this, that and the other, but he's very, very talented. It was always the plan to come here but we felt we needed to run him a few times over two miles first to get the freshness out of him. He's learning his job well and I'd imagine we'll be thinking of Aintree. Brian (Hughes) wants me to go to Ayr, which comes first this year, but it's all up in the air - Donald McCain, trainer.

quotes.race: Ballymore Sidney Banks Novices' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Minella Drama has always been a nice horse and his form has been solid. Every run has stacked up well, the horses he has beaten and who beat him first time have all come out and won and have good ratings now. He's progressing with every run and he's going to be a nice chaser next season. It was suiting us to run him over two miles because the right races were there but he does stay this trip and I dare say he might get three miles in time. But we'll take it one step at a time - Brian Hughes, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: He's been a wonderful horse and has been there when we needed him. I was really pleased with his comeback in the Old Roan. He's a year older now but he ran another great race. The difficulty is where we go now, so we'll have to pick and choose right. He prefers a bit of better ground, jumps a little bit right but prefers to go left and he doesn't seem to like travelling to the south for some reason. He qualifies for veterans' chases and if he gets his sort of circumstances, he's still very useful. 30-10-25

A very talented horse who has won six of his 15 races and looks as good as ever. He was a decent third to Hitman on his penultimate run before running out an easy winner from Cooper's Cross, who gave the form a huge boost when subsequently winning the Sky Bet. I had wanted to see how he would cope over hurdles in the Champion Hurdle Trial at Haydock but that was frozen off, so with no similar options coming up he will stick to chasing. He is not a big flashy chaser, but he has an engine and I hope to run him in the Ascot Chase over 2m5f later this month if the ground is slow, as that race and track would be right up his street. 09-02-23

prev_owners.owner: Michael G Cohen And David Cohen

quotes.race: bet365 Perth Gold Cup Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Statuario always turns up and does us proud. He'll have to go for the Summer Plate now - Mickey Bowen, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

quotes.race: bet365 Perth Gold Cup Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It's essential Statuario goes right-handed. We thought he was a two-and-a-half-miler but when he ran the other day all he did was stay. It was the same here, so hopefully we can go for the Summer Plate now; maybe he and Francky Du Berlais can line up together. That was a brilliant win. This had been the aim for a long time, so we're delighted - Michael Bowen, joint-trainer, speaking on Racing TV.

quotes.race: Geoff Williams Birthday Novices' Hurdle
quotes.quote: Statuario was getting plenty of weight from the favourite Capone and, in the end, that was what swayed it. He is the type we will mix and match hurdling and the Flat over the summer. - Peter Bowen, trainer

stable_tour.quote: He missed the Topham last year by two horses, which was a real shame. Hopefully he'll get into it this year as he's off the same mark. He's as good as ever and you wouldn't think he's the age he is. He'll have a crack at the Topham as he's never run in it, but the main aim after that will be the Perth Gold Cup again. Whatever he does before then, it's all about having him ready to win that once more. 26-03-26

quotes.race: George Rickards Birthday Mares' Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Della Casa Lunga is a nice horse and likes Ludlow, she's got better as the season's gone on. We know how best to ride her now so hopefully she'll continue to go on from this - Clive Boultbee-Brooks, owner-trainer.

quotes.race: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction Novice Hurdle (IRE Incentive Race)
quotes.quote: Della Casa Lunga deserved that, she had been running well. She had a few hard races in bumpers and is probably only coming to herself. We will aim for the final at Punchestown and give her a run before then - Sam Curling, trainer

stable_tour.quote: The rain probably came at the wrong time at Aintree on Sunday, but he's a lovely old horse who jumps great and looks ideal for staying veterans' chases. He's really tough on his day. 29-10-25

prev_owners.owner: Off The Clock Partners & Dr RDP Newland

stable_tour.quote: He ran a very nice race at Kelso on Saturday but just got a little bit tired. He missed some work after a wind operation in September and it was a very strongly run race, which just caught him out in the closing stages. The handicapper has dropped him to 114 and he's won off higher than that. I haven't got a race in mind but I think he can rate higher. Although he's won plenty of races, I still think he can compete at a higher level. He travelled very well at Kelso considering the pace they went and that the ground was a bit quick. He stays very well too. 21-11-24

quotes.race: Camden Town Brewery Handicap
quotes.quote: That was lovely. Fouroneohfever is a big-framed horse and he will continue to improve. It was his turf debut and a tough learning curve in front of a big crowd - he looks a nice horse - Henry Morshead, assistant trainer.

quotes.race: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Handicap
quotes.quote: I wasn't actually sure whether I got up or not. We didn't go very quick but Rossa (Ryan, jockey on runner-up) put an injection of pace going round the bend and I was more trying to teach Fouroneohfever how to race. He's had three runs and he's still learning on the job. He's a horse we're going to be seeing over longer distances and he really wasn't in love with the track. He's got a massive stride and he's made for turf racing so when he gets on turf on a bigger track he can hopefully climb through the ranks - Billy Loughnane, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

stable_tour.quote: He could have done with slower ground last time and ran a bit fresh, but I was pleased as he'd been off the track a while. I think we would have seen a bit more if we'd had some more typical Doncaster weather. He could step up in trip and something like the Copper Horse could be a target if we can get his rating high enough. 07-04-25

quotes.race: EBF "National Hunt" Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: A Different Kind is a grand horse, he's switched off and just does what you ask him to. He could go to Musselburgh for the trials meeting - Donald McCain, trainer.

quotes.race: Oakmere Homes "Introductory" Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: A Different Kind is a horse we've always liked and we've made no secret of that. Although there were only three runners, the second horse was rated 89 on the Flat and was getting 5lb. The ground was probably slower than ideal and it was a good enough performance - Brian Hughes, rider.

stable_tour.quote: A smashing little horse we bought off Derek O'Connor who won first time out (by 15 lengths) as expected at Sedgefield. We returned there three weeks later where he defied his penalty when winning by ten lengths. He goes bacj there again on Thursday and looks a nice prospect. He'll get 2m4f and he jumps well as he ran a good second on his only point start. 10-11-21

quotes.race: Burlington Female Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle (Pro/Am Race)
quotes.quote: We knew there was going to be plenty of pace on and that set the race up perfectly for her, because Winds Of Winter travels away really well and just needs something to aim at - Thomasina Eyston, winning jockey talking to Racing TV.

runners.owner: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing
Call It What You Like Syndicate

quotes.race: Willwego.com Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I thought Someone's Wish would come on for the run. Jack [Kennedy, jockey] said they went very fast up front and it played into his hands. He held onto him as long as he could and said he'd come on plenty from it - Gordon Elliott, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

stable_tour.quote: It was nice to see him get his head back in front at Downpatrick and we've him pencilled in for the 2m handicap chase at Down Royal this week. 26-10-25

quotes.race: Edinburgh Gin Seaside Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: It's a track Just Dottie likes. Although Ben [Smith] wasn't riding today, he did tell me of the jockeys available Sean Bowen was the man for it and it'd suit him perfectly. She'll go two or three times in the summer. It was a big step up today to find out just what we've got, but to do that was fantastic - Mike Smith, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

quotes.race: DM Hall Surveyors Mares' Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I'm very happy that we've got Just Dottie to win it for the second year running. She's done everything right again today. When I've asked her to pick up between the last two she really has and she's gone away and won quite nicely - Ben Smith, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

stable_tour.quote: She was fifth on her first run back following a 227-day break at Perth last time and, if you listened to the commentary, you'd say she was something of an eyecatcher. She goes to Perth again on Thursday in the race she won last year and she should go well. 16-05-24

quotes.race: Ayrshire Wedding Show At Ayr Racecourse Novices' Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I didn't really want to run Beat The Retreat on today's ground but the owner was keen. We could have waited until new year but it might have been even softer so we thought we'd take our chance, and it paid off - Nick Alexander, trainer.

quotes.quote: I thought Sao Carlos's jumping was great up the straight. I loved the way he went through the race, he gave me a really classy feel, although when he came off the bridle it took a while for the penny to drop - Gavin Sheehan, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: We haven't seen the best from him but he had an underlying issue last season, hence his dip in form towards the end. He'll be seen at the end of next month and is handicapped to be very competitive. 24-10-24

He won a bumper at Market Rasen last season and we'll start off in a maiden in the middle of the month. He is doing everything nicely and jumps great, so he seems like a good young novice to get excited about. 01-11-23

quotes.race: Achieving Potential Tom Halliday Memorial Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I let Malangen stretch on round the back and he probably won the race there, but I didn't realise we were sixty-three lengths clear. He started to get a bit tired in the straight so I had to give him a reminder. He's a very strong front-runner and a hardy old handicapper. I'm used to riding against him all the time up north, so you get to know his strengths and weaknesses. He's a credit to Lisa and her team - Alan Doyle, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: A lovely, big scopey horse who'll hopefully get a run at the backend. He'll come into his own next year and we'll start him off over a mile. 03-09-21

runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Casual Ob

stable_tour.quote: He was quite weak and immature last season, so we focused on building up his experience over hurdles. I'd be disappointed if he's not a bit better than his rating. 01-11-24

We were disappointed with his handicap hurdle debut at Haydock on his return last season, when he overraced a bit and didn't give himself a chance. The run knocked the gas out of him, though, and he won next time at Ffos Las, after which an injury meant he missed the rest of the season. He's a proper soft-ground horse and he'll go novice handicap chasing. He's fairly unexposed and I feel there's more to come. 22-10-25

quotes.race: William Hill Epic Value Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Lady In The Park has improved in the last month or so. She has possibilities of going on to be okay. She wants further - Peter Scudamore, assistant trainer.

stable_tour.quote: She's a lovely mare who really pleased me in the bumper at Aintree last month when finishing under a length behind the winner in third. She'll go straight over hurdles now. 15-11-23

quotes.race: Mark Nield Wealth Management Go North Monet's Garden Series Final Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: We always fancied William Of York as a chaser and just hope he gets three miles in time. He's not Third Time Lucki or Captain Chaos, but he's going the right way - you haven't seen the best of him yet and will improve. He'll come back to us for a good summer holiday too - Mike Newbould, owner.

stable_tour.quote: He got a lot stronger last season and continued to improve as a chaser, ending up by winning the Monet's Garden Go North final at Carlisle. He jumps very well - he's bold and quick but very rarely gets one wrong - and will be entered for the Grand Sefton at Aintree. 16-10-24

We changed tactics at Carlisle the other day and it worked wonders as he was probably getting a bit sick of being bullied out in front. We're thinking of going for another Edinburgh National as he's got to go right-handed. He seems much more back to himself. 29-10-25

quotes.race: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 519 Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Qualifier)
quotes.quote: It went to plan, and it was lovely to win. Sir Carnegie's jumping keeps improving and he stays very well. If he'd jumped as well at Sedgefield last time, he'd have won. We ran him in a chase at Hexham, but he was jumping a bit novicey, which is why we went back to hurdles. He's had a few falls over hurdles, and you can see he's just getting his confidence up now as he's getting better with every race. He stays all day, and we'll just keep getting him relaxed. He's growing with every run, and hopefully he'll just keep improving - Mickey Bowen, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He's bouncing around the place and will be ready in about two weeks. There's a nice 0-100 novice handicap chase at Newcastle and I know it's a long way to travel there from our base in Wales, but we think he can win it. He'll take a lot of beating in it. 26-03-26

quotes.race: Go North Monet's Garden Series Final Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Uptown Harry ran terribly at Newcastle but the ground was jarring and he didn't let himself down on it, but he ran a solid race back here next time and we knew we were on the right track. We prayed for rain for a month and we managed to get it. We were pretty confident today. We knew he'd love the ground and he loves going right handed. And this is his track - they just don't put enough races on for him! - Jane Walton, trainer.

runners.breeder: Mme Elza Petit & Mme Hannah Petit

stable_tour.quote: I bought him very cheaply at £2,500. We were running him on the Flat but I think we've found the key to him now. He'll win on the Flat, but we've popped him over hurdles the last few times. He's been second and then won before Christmas at Lingfield, so he's going the right way. 01-01-25

He ran a nice race when third in a 2m maiden hurdle at Southwell last time behind Desertmore News. He probably wants further but is just beginning to learn his trade. He's a backward sort, a typical homebred who's just taking a bit of time to get the hang of it. Each run has been encouraging enough. He ran nicely at Carlisle to start with over hurdles, where I cunningly ran him in what looked like a good race won by Mydaddypaddy. He then got stuck in the mud at Exeter, which was unlucky - it was just atrocious weather - and then he ran that nice race at Southwell, so he's coming along nicely. He's got a mark of 105 now, so we might go in a handicap, but we'll see what we can find. 18-02-26
